plan: A tank support who hooks onto his target with his anchor and roots it again and again.
aSurveiller: His Q (Dredge Line). His anchor pulls you to him: stay behind your minions, it stops on the first one hit.
contrer: Stay behind your minions: his anchor (Q) stops on the first one hit.
His R chases you: try to put an ally between you.
His first attack roots you: keep your distance.

sorts.Q: Anchor that pulls both towards each other.
sorts.R: Shockwave that chases and knocks up.
